findings.title: Carle’s Rantoul clinic temporarily closed for ‘elevated levels of moisture’ inside building
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Carle Health's clinic in Rantoul is temporarily closed amidst what was referred to as "elevated levels of moisture" inside.
findings.service_line: outpatient clinic (specific specialties, including primary care, not independently verified)
findings.access_consequences: The clinic location is temporarily closed; Carle says appointments are being relocated and affected patients contacted. Reopening date and alternative appointment sites were not provided.
findings.affected_population: Patients whose visits at the Rantoul clinic are disrupted; count unknown.

coverage_notes.findings_time_note: Rantoul WCIA story was updated October 30 at 21:53 UTC (14:53 PDT), earlier than the prior watch. Newly identified in this recall, not claimed to have begun in the current one-hour interval. Closure began at an undisclosed time. Carle spokesman confirmed appointment relocation; specialty scope was not verified. No assumption of ED closure.
coverage_notes.limitations: Search engines can miss rural, tribal and territory local reporting; finding is based on syndication of WCIA reporting, not a directly opened Carle statement or first-party notice. Online clinic directory does not establish the closed site's service lines. Exact closure start/end and number of affected patients remain unknown.
coverage_notes.controls: Exactly one new watch-only heartbeat on ops/watch-ledger; no approval, public publication, production collector change, schedule update or task disabling.
